<!--
This is not a defect or a misfit. Both of those are about a rule the prelude already states;
this is about a procedure it lacks.

A skill written once is a local skill. A skill written twice, independently, is the argument
for moving it upstream: nobody should have to write it a third time. Name both repositories.

Send a skill marked `status: built`. A stub names a procedure without being one, and there
is nothing to promote.

As with any report, please do not send corpus content. The procedure is what moves upstream;
the nodes it was run against stay in your repository.
-->

## What is domain-specific in it

<!--
The class names, sources, or thresholds that would not survive the move. A skill that is
